summary: An announcement that the Network Graphics Group meeting is confirmed for July 16-17, 1973 at the University of Illinois at Urbana, with an informal agenda session the evening before. Attendees are asked to read RFC 493 on graphics protocols first, and travel and lodging details are given.

plainLanguage.summary: This RFC confirms a Network Graphics Group meeting at the University of Illinois on July 16 and 17. It also gives an informal planning time, reading suggestion, and travel information.

subtitle: Confirmation and travel details for a Network Graphics Group meeting.

tldr.problem: The Network Graphics Group needed confirmation of its proposed meeting date and practical arrangements for attendees.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC confirms the University of Illinois location and gives meeting, reading, lodging, and travel information.
tldr.outcome: The notice asks prospective attendees to tell the organizer whether they plan to attend; it does not give meeting results.

sections.title: Meeting Date and Place
sections.content:
The proposed Network Graphics Group meeting was confirmed for July 16 and 17 at the University of Illinois. An informal gathering to arrange the agenda was scheduled for Sunday evening, July 15.

The initial meeting place was Room 201 in the Advanced Computation Building in Urbana; the notice says a larger room might be used if needed.
sections.plainLanguage: The group would meet at the University of Illinois on July 16 and 17. An informal agenda-planning meeting was set for the evening before.

sections.title: Preparation and Arrangements
sections.content:
The notice recommends that attendees read James Michener's RFC 493 on graphics protocols. It gives lodging options and asks people, if possible, to tell Steve Bunch whether they planned to attend so he could estimate the space needed.

The announcement also discusses airline arrangements and notes that Ozark was experiencing a pilot strike at the time.
sections.plainLanguage: Attendees were asked to read RFC 493 and tell the organizer if they planned to come. The note also gives lodging and travel information.

sections.title: Scope of the Announcement
sections.content: RFC 537 confirms the meeting and supplies logistics. It does not summarize discussions or decisions made at the meeting.
sections.plainLanguage: This RFC is a meeting notice. It does not report what the group decided.

references.text: Michener, J., "Protocols for Data Streams in Graphics", RFC 493, April 16, 1973.
